name: Dropdown
summary: A trigger button that reveals a floating overlay of actions — with leading icons, dividers, disabled rows and a dark danger action.
highlights: Trigger button revealing a floating overlay of actions
Leading icons, dividers and disabled rows
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-dropdown> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. A trigger button reveals a floating overlay from the `items` list. The overlay is a Menu of the DS V3 item family, not a flat list: rows carry leading icons, a divider rules them off, an item can be disabled or a dark danger action, can carry a `description` (a smaller muted second line under the label) or a `shortcut` (the action's key as the shared DS shortcut chip at the row's trailing edge on the label line: ⌘D on a Mac, Ctrl D elsewhere, for a context menu), and a group title splits sections. With a `value` attribute the dropdown is also a short single-choice picker (a role picker with descriptions): the row whose key equals `value` is the brand-tinted selected row, the trigger shows its label, and choosing a row sets `value`. An item that carries `children:[…]` is a submenu-parent: hovering it (or ArrowRight / Enter) opens a SECOND floating panel to the side — a flyout, positioned adjacent to the parent row, with edge-collision handling (it flips to the other side when there's no room); ArrowLeft / Escape closes the flyout back to the parent. `placement` positions the overlay (bottomLeft default · bottomRight · topLeft · topRight) and `trigger` is click (default) or hover. Open/close animates via the shared motion tokens on a PERSISTENT panel (a class toggles — the subtree is never rebuilt on open), the caret rotates, every flyout fades/scales in on its own persistent node, and it closes on outside-click or Escape (focus returns to the trigger). The open panel sits in the browser top layer (Popover API) at a position measured from the trigger, so a card or scroll area with overflow hidden, a transform or a z-index layer never clips or covers it; it follows scroll and resize, opens on the other vertical side when its own side lacks room, and stays 8px inside the viewport. `open` reflects the panel state and can be set from code; composed `open` and `close` events report every open and close the user makes. A leaf with `locked:true` is a plan-gated row: it keeps its normal look, shows the shared Paywall crown at its trailing edge, and a click, Enter or Space opens that row's Paywall popover beside it instead of choosing it. Every glyph — the trigger caret, the submenu caret, each leading icon — is the DS icon by name via <aha-icon>. Emits a composed `select`, `open` and `close`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `select`, `open`, `close` and, for locked rows, the Paywall's `paywall-upgrade`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Trigger
spec.value: height 40 · radius 8 · white bg, 1px border #E3E3E3, SemiBold 600

spec.label: Trigger hover
spec.value: border-hover #E70E68 (motion-fast + ease-out)

spec.label: Loading
spec.value: `loading` swaps the caret for the 16px DS spinner (aha-spin .7s linear, currentColor), cursor progress, aria-busy=true; the panel cannot open while it is set

spec.label: Caret
spec.value: <aha-icon name="system-caret-down" size=16>, rotates 180° when open (motion-mid)

spec.label: Panel
spec.value: elevated white, radius 8, 4 padding, sized to content (width max-content), min-width 210 and max-width min(320px, 90vw), both including padding and border (the flyout too), a long label ellipsis, a long description wraps, soft shadow

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: bottomLeft · bottomRight · topLeft · topRight — the preferred side and edge; the panel opens on the other vertical side when its own side lacks room and is clamped 8px inside the viewport

spec.label: Top layer
spec.value: the open panel is shown in the browser top layer (popover=manual) and placed with position:fixed 6px from the trigger, re-measured on scroll and resize, so an overflow-hidden card, a transform or a z-index ancestor cannot clip or cover it; without the Popover API the fixed panel still escapes an overflow ancestor

spec.label: Open state and events
spec.value: `open` attribute and property reflect the panel; setting it opens or closes the panel without an event. Composed `open` / `close` (no detail) fire on every user open and close: trigger, keyboard, hover, outside-click, Escape, Tab out and choosing an item (`close`, then `select`)

spec.label: Trigger mode
spec.value: click (default) or hover

spec.label: Open motion
spec.value: opacity + translateY on a persistent node (motion-mid + ease-out)

spec.label: Item
spec.value: min-height 40 · padding 8 12 · radius 4 · 10px gap to a 16px leading icon in icon-default #4A4A4A · label Regular 400 · hover bg-hover #F7F7F7 (neutral, not a brand tint)

spec.label: Description
spec.value: optional second line, 6px below the label: size-sm 12px / 16px line, text-secondary #4A4A4A (text-disabled on a disabled row, text-inverse while a danger row is hovered), wraps onto as many lines as it needs, never truncated; the row grows to fit; part=description

spec.label: Shortcut
spec.value: optional `shortcut` on a leaf ("Mod+D", "Del", "Shift+Enter"): the shared DS shortcut chip (lib/shortcut-key.js, as Button and Tooltip draw it: 24px high, radius-xs 4, 6px side padding, a single key a 24 × 24 square, 14px Regular 400 on a 16% currentColor wash; ⌘D on a Mac, Ctrl D elsewhere) pinned to the row's trailing edge on the label line, also when the row has a description; text-secondary #4A4A4A, text-disabled #B5B5B5 on a disabled row, the row colour on a danger row (white while it is hovered); display only and aria-hidden, the row carries aria-keyshortcuts ("Meta+D" on a Mac, "Control+D" elsewhere); part=shortcut; on a locked row the chip sits before the crown

spec.label: Selected item
spec.value: only with a `value` attribute: the row whose key equals `value` takes bg-accent #E70E680D, text-default #1A1A1A and SemiBold 600 on the label (a description stays Regular 400), no check mark; leaf rows become role=menuitemradio with aria-checked; the trigger shows the selected label unless `label` is set; opening focuses the selected row; hover on it keeps the tint

spec.label: Danger item
spec.value: color-error #1A1A1A text; hover fills button-danger-bg #1A1A1A with white text

spec.label: Divider
spec.value: 1px border-disabled #EBEBEB rule, role=separator

spec.label: Group title
spec.value: 11px uppercase, text-tertiary #8A8A8A, non-interactive section header

spec.label: Disabled item
spec.value: text-disabled #B5B5B5, not-allowed

spec.label: Locked item
spec.value: a leaf with `locked:true`: label and icon keep their normal colours (not the disabled grey); the shared <aha-paywall> crown (the 16px Vivid Pink upgrade mark) sits 12px from the trailing edge with the label padded clear of it; a click, Enter or Space opens the row's Paywall popover (title = the label, body = `upgradeBody`, the plan's unlock line, Upgrade + See all plans) 8px beside the crown, vertically centred on the row, or above / below it via fitPaywall when the side lacks room; never emits `select`; role menuitem with aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded, described by "Requires the Pro plan." (or Essential); the row keeps bg-hover #F7F7F7 while its popover is open; `disabled` wins over `locked`

spec.label: Submenu parent
spec.value: item with children[]; aria-haspopup=menu, trailing <aha-icon name="system-caret-right" size=16>; brand-tinted (bg-accent #E70E680D, color-primary #E70E68) while its flyout is open

spec.label: Flyout
spec.value: second elevated panel adjacent to the parent (left:100%), opens on hover / ArrowRight / Enter; fades+scales on a persistent node (motion-mid + ease-out)

spec.label: Edge-collision flip
spec.value: flyout measures on open; if it overflows the viewport it flips to open on the left (right:100%)

spec.label: Flyout keyboard
spec.value: Up/Down within the flyout, ArrowLeft / Escape closes it back to the parent (focus returns to the parent row)

spec.label: Locked item keyboard
spec.value: Enter / Space opens or closes the popover and focus stays on the row; Tab moves to Upgrade, then See all plans, then on to the next row (closing the popover); Shift+Tab from Upgrade returns to the row; Escape closes the popover first (focus back on the row) and a second Escape closes the menu; moving to another row closes it

spec.label: Custom trigger
spec.value: an element in `slot="trigger"` replaces the default button (the default is hidden while one is slotted); the dropdown sets aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded on it, opens it on click, Enter, Space and ArrowDown, and returns focus to it on Escape or choosing a row; an icon-only trigger needs an aria-label

props.name: value
props.desc: Makes the dropdown a single-choice picker: the leaf whose key equals this is the selected row (brand-tinted, semibold, no check mark) and, with no `label`, the trigger text. Choosing a leaf sets it, closes the panel and emits select. Leave it off for an action dropdown

props.name: items
props.desc: Rows. Leaf {key,label,description?,shortcut?,icon?,disabled?,danger?,testid?} (`testid` is rendered as data-testid on the row; `shortcut` draws the key as the DS shortcut chip on the row's trailing edge, display only, and the row gets aria-keyshortcuts); locked leaf {key,label,locked:true,plan?,featureKey?,upgradeBody?} → opens a Paywall popover instead of selecting (`plan` pro default or essential); submenu-parent {key,label,icon?,children:[…]} → adjacent flyout; rule {type:'divider'}; section {type:'group',label,children:[]}

props.name: loading
props.desc: Shows the DS spinner in place of the caret and blocks opening (click, keyboard and hover), as Button's loading does. The trigger carries aria-busy

props.name: placement
props.desc: Where the overlay opens relative to the trigger

props.name: slot="trigger"
props.desc: Your own trigger control, such as an icon-only aha-button with an aria-label for a kebab (three-dot) menu. Opt-in: without it the default button renders unchanged.

props.name: open
props.desc: Reflects whether the panel is open; set or remove it to open or close the panel from code (a controlled dropdown). Setting it fires no event. open="false" counts as closed. React 19 assigns the property, so `open={isOpen}` works as written. React 18 writes a string attribute: `open={true}` becomes open="true" and `open={false}` becomes open="false", which is read as closed; the recommended pattern is `open={isOpen ? '' : undefined}`, which omits the attribute when closed.

props.name: select
props.desc: Composed event on choosing an item, detail { key }

props.name: open / close
props.desc: Composed events (no detail) on every user open and close: click, Enter, Space, ArrowDown or hover opens; the trigger, outside-click, Escape, Tab out, hover out or choosing an item closes (close fires before select). Setting `open` fires neither

props.name: paywall-shown / paywall-upgrade / paywall-plans
props.desc: A locked row's Paywall events, composed, so they bubble out of the dropdown: detail { feature, plan } from the row's `featureKey` and `plan`. `paywall-upgrade` and `paywall-plans` are cancelable (preventDefault() to run your own upgrade flow instead of opening pricing); either one also closes the menu

whenToUse.when: a set of actions or options should sit behind a trigger to save space
the same list belongs inline, always visible — not behind a trigger
the control picks a single value for a form field, not fires an action
a short single-choice picker outside a form, such as a role picker with a description under each choice

opinion.note: A dropdown holds actions or navigation; use Select for a form field. Set `value` when it acts as a short single-choice picker outside a form (a role picker with descriptions): do not hand-roll it from Menu inside a Popover. Keep the item list short; the panel closes on outside-click and Escape. Give each action a leading icon, rule off a destructive action with a divider and mark it danger. Reach for a submenu-parent (children[]) only when a group of related actions would otherwise crowd the top level — one level of flyout is plenty; deeper nesting is a menu smell. The overlay reuses the shared Menu item vocabulary rather than reinventing the row styling. A plan-gated action stays in the list as a `locked` row, never hidden or disabled: it opens the shared Paywall popover in place, so do not hand-roll a Popover on the row.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Dropdown-Menu + Components/Dropdown/Menu-Item + Dropdown/Menu-Item-Group component sets: the overlay is a Menu of items carrying leading icons, dividers, group titles, disabled + danger rows — the same item family as Menu — plus submenu-parents whose children[] open an adjacent flyout (the DS V3 Menu-Item nested/expandable variant, here as a floating flyout with a trailing system-caret-right and aria-haspopup). Reference contract measured keys (dropdown|menu radius 8, dropdown|item height 40 with hover/focus states) plus the token layer: white trigger, border #E3E3E3, border-hover, bg-elevated panel, color-error danger, text-tertiary group title, radius-default 8; the flyout reuses the same elevated-panel + item tokens, and the open submenu-parent takes the brand-tinted bg-accent / color-primary highlight. Placement (bottomLeft/bottomRight/topLeft/topRight) + click/hover trigger from AntD Dropdown conventions; the flyout does edge-collision flip like AntD's rc-menu submenu. Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent panels (root + each flyout); every glyph from the DS icon library.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe opens on load AND opens its submenu flyout, so the trigger, the panel's danger item, the submenu-parent (aria-haspopup + caret) and the flyout panel are all measurable together.
